passages.title: Memo: daily meal allowance exceptions
passages.heading: Exception for client-site days in London or Paris
passages.text: For client-site days in London or Paris, the daily meal allowance is 76 EUR per day instead of the standard amount. Line managers check each claim for plausibility before it is released for payment. Repeated late or incomplete claims may be escalated to the head of the department. The policy owner may publish clarifications in the policy FAQ without changing this section.

passages.title: Travel policy: meals
passages.heading: Additions
passages.meta: version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-02-01 · supersedes: HB-01
passages.text: For a day with an approved client dinner, 28 EUR per day is added to the standard daily meal allowance. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance team together with the policy owner. Supporting records are kept for seven years in line with the retention schedule. Employees should keep costs reasonable and book through the approved channels where possible.

passages.title: Travel policy: meals

passages.title: Policy FAQ
passages.heading: Current daily meal allowance
passages.text: Q: What is the current standard daily meal allowance? A: 60 EUR per day, as set in HB-33 §2 (effective 2026-02-01). Group exceptions are listed in HB-35.

passages.title: Travel policy: meals
passages.heading: Standard daily meal allowance
passages.meta: version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-01-01 to the day before 2026-02-01 · superseded by: HB-33
passages.text: The daily meal allowance during business travel was 44 EUR per day. Repeated late or incomplete claims may be escalated to the head of the department. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header. Audit samples are drawn every quarter, and selected employees are asked for documentation.

passages.title: Travel policy: meals
passages.heading: Standard daily meal allowance
passages.meta: version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-02-01 · supersedes: HB-01
passages.text: The daily meal allowance during business travel is 60 EUR per day. The policy owner may publish clarifications in the policy FAQ without changing this section. Receipts must be attached for every item claimed; photographs of paper receipts are accepted. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header.

passages.title: Memo: daily meal allowance exceptions
passages.heading: Purpose
passages.text: This memo lists group exceptions to the daily meal allowance in HB-33. Claims that combine several costs must list each cost on a separate line of the claim. Where a local agreement sets stricter rules, the stricter rule applies for that location. Supporting records are kept for seven years in line with the retention schedule.

passages.title: Memo: daily meal allowance exceptions
passages.heading: Carve-out
passages.text: The exception above does not apply to interns; they follow the standard daily meal allowance in HB-33 §2. Supporting records are kept for seven years in line with the retention schedule. Audit samples are drawn every quarter, and selected employees are asked for documentation. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance team together with the policy owner.
